_README: TEMPLATE for the hardware_config_fa400_glbl variable. Import it at commissioning after filling the null values in. A null here means the value is MEASURED or READ OFF the installed hardware and has no default: the software will not guess one, and it keeps the affected function disabled until the value exists.

sensor_recovery._README: R02 diagnosis and R13 recovery. Diagnostics may run while the power reset stays disabled, and that is the intended commissioning order. OUT7 ON means RESET ACTIVE: the K_MODBUS_SENSOR_RESET NC contact opens the COMMON Modbus sensor +24 V. Sensor 0 V is never switched. Fan supply, fan analogue commands, the fan 5 V fallback, the heartbeat output, the Sinum modules and the Sinclair SCMI are NOT on that rail.
_commissioning_gates_NOT_RUN: CHK-SR-01 the relay's NC contact exists (physical inspection)
CHK-SR-02 the contact's voltage and current suit the 24 V PELV circuit
CHK-SR-03 the 230 V coil and the 24 V PELV contact are separated
CHK-SR-04 the actual PS-08m OUT7 binding and its SBus device id -> reset_output_sbus_id
CHK-SR-05 the real inventory of devices on the switched sensor rail
CHK-SR-06 the measured device boot delay -> boot_wait_s
CHK-SR-07 the physical 5 s pulse and the restoration of power
CHK-SR-08 recovery proven from data received AFTER the reset
CHK-SR-09 the OUT7 state when the health watchdog stops immediately after an ON command, with the controller and PS-08m still powered
CHK-SR-10 whether PS-08m provides a proven native timed-pulse facility; nothing assumes it
CHK-SR-11 the Main PLC decodes input 95-99 per the integration contract, tolerates exception 2, retains the input 98 sequence, and does not stop the AHU on this block alone
CHK-SR-12 the relay's actual A1/A2 and COM/NC terminal numbers - no factory terminal data exists, so the designations in use are design designations

_fixed.note: The outdoor address is a fixed owner invariant and is not configurable. Supply and chamber addresses come from hardware_config_ch1.json - modbus.supply_slave_id and modbus.chamber_slave_id - so there is no second source of truth. pulse_s is fixed at 5 for this installation and is validated: any other value leaves the reset unarmed.

chamber_backup._README: The Main PLC chamber measurement (Modbus holding 5-10) as the chamber program's BACKUP. The chamber controls on its local chamber sensor first and takes the PLC measurement only while the local sensor is unusable. Commissioning defaults, offline-tested, not validated on the plant.

_notes.plc_fresh_s: 30..600 s. How old a PLC sample may be and still be used. The PLC sends once a minute; 150 s rides out one missed transmission with margin.
_notes.local_return_s: 0..600 s. Continuous local-sensor usability required before control returns to it; immediate when the PLC sample is unusable.

hum_fallback._README: AH-feedback fallback of the humidifier. With the outdoor AH unusable for 60 s the humidifier doses on the bounded feedback alone: the supply AH (the supply T/RH sensor sits AFTER the humidifier), else the chamber program's selected chamber AH. ON by default; enabled=false takes it away.

hum_feedback._README: Bounded integral feedback on top of the outdoor-AH feed-forward (and the whole dose in the fallback). Commissioning defaults, offline-tested against a simple plant model, not validated on the plant.
hum_feedback._ranges: supply_ki_per_min 0..1, chamber_ki_per_min 0..0.5, deadbands 0..2 g/m3, trim_max_g_m3 0..5 g/m3; an out-of-range entry is ignored and its default kept

inverter_temp._README: Anti-cycling of the inverter's demand-driven mode changes. Safety stops (airflow, lost chamber feedback, inactive chamber control, AHU disabled) are immediate and never wait for these. Commissioning defaults, not measured on this unit.
inverter_temp._ranges: 0..1800 s each; 0 turns the respective guard off
